answer: Latency Spiral Admission. New identities must answer intermittent timing challenges whose required response window follows a decaying spiral: each correct reply shortens the next deadline by a fixed ratio, and misses reset the sequence. Honest agents on stable links harbor enough clock slack to converge; bulk-registered sybils share congested paths and collide. Each surviving identity costs sustained low-jitter scheduling plus idle probe traffic, and a plume of failed challenges flags and throttles the origin.
